text.content:
Danger Gal's Art Deco headquarters, now the Arasaka Liaison Office.

Region: Downtown, City Center, a few blocks west of Camden Court
Controlled by: Arasaka
The feel of it: Same clock, same pink carpet inside (they're still ripping it out), and a trifoliate over the door
Danger: SC 10: Arasaka Security, Hardened Medium

Danger Gal's headquarters until 2069. It was part of the price Michiko Arasaka paid to go home to the family, and she works on the thirteenth floor as Arasaka's Accord Liaison. Eight blocks east, the cat's eye on Danger Gal's Bridgehead watches the Waterfront, and Minako's office has one number on speed dial, which rings here.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05, 07
